verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an open-source library installed via pip. Its persisted state lives in checkpointers and stores the developer controls, including a self-hosted Postgres-backed checkpointer, so data is not locked inside a vendor service and could be extracted from your own database. However, nothing documents an explicit export path or open-format guarantees. Missing for 10: a documented export/migration feature, an explicit open-format specification for checkpoint/store data, guidance for leaving managed deployment, and independent corroboration of portability.
